extension.description: Foreign affiliates are enterprises resident in one country and controlled by an institutional unit resident in another country. Inward Foreign Affiliates Statistics (IFATS) measure the activities of enterprises resident in EU Member States that are under foreign control. Annual data by NACE Rev. 2 activity and country of control cover the number of enterprises, employment, output, value added, turnover, purchases, investment, gross operating surplus and related productivity and profitability indicators. They provide information on the economic activity and performance of foreign-controlled enterprises in EU economies. This table provides a more detailed breakdown by NACE Rev. 2 activity, covering business market producers as defined by NACE Sections B-S, except Section O and Division 94, for a selected number of countries where the ultimate controlling institutional unit (UCI) is resident.
